source.edition: Spain harmonised application form ES-EN-ZH, retrieved 2026-07-31

questions.label: 1. Surname(s)
questions.guidance: Enter the surname exactly as shown in the travel document. The Workspace converts letters to uppercase.

questions.label: 2. Surname at birth
questions.guidance: Enter the surname held at birth even when it is the same as the current surname. Do not leave this required field blank.

questions.label: Sex
questions.prompt: Select the applicant sex shown on the form.

questions.label: Previous Schengen fingerprints
questions.prompt: Were fingerprints previously collected for a Schengen visa application?

questions.label: Relationship to the EU family member
Applicant means of support
questions.prompt: Select every means provided by the applicant.

questions.label: Travel costs paid by
questions.prompt: Select every party covering travel and living costs.

questions.label: Sponsor identity
questions.prompt: Identify where the sponsor is specified.

questions.label: Sponsor means of support
questions.prompt: Select every means provided by the sponsor.

questions.label: Inviting person or accommodation name
questions.prompt: What is the name of the inviting person, hotel, or temporary accommodation?

questions.label: Entries requested
questions.prompt: Select the requested number of entries.

questions.label: 24. Additional information on purpose of stay
questions.prompt: 24. Additional information on purpose of stay

questions.label: Purpose of journey
questions.prompt: Select every purpose that applies to this journey.

questions.label: Residence outside nationality country
questions.prompt: Does the applicant reside outside the country of current nationality?

questions.label: Travel document type
questions.prompt: Select the applicant travel document type.

approval.reviewer: Visa Master visual review of the curated form map
notes: Field 2 surname at birth remains required even when it repeats the current surname.
Choice groups, selection cardinality, and all conditions use the executable v1 contract.
Starred fields 21, 22, 30, 31, and 32 are suppressed for qualifying EU-family applicants.
Field 19 gives the e-mail placement sufficient width while preserving the address and telephone boundaries.
Normal adult, conditional/minor/sponsor, EU-family, accented Latin, and CJK synthetic scenarios were rendered and visually reviewed on all affected pages.
